english.title: Destroy / dispose of / falsify / conceal document to be produced under s. 26 / 27 / 28 / 28A of the Competition Act 1998
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been required under section

(A)_[26]_
(B)_[27]_
(C)_[28]_
(D)_[28A]_

of the Competition Act 1998 to produce a document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..),

(E)_[intentionally or recklessly destroyed it or otherwise disposed of it]_
(F)_[falsified it]_
(G)_[concealed it]_

english.notes: A person does not commit this offence by reason of any act or omission in relation to which the Competition and Markets Authority has proceeded by issuing a civil penalty under section 40ZE(1) of the Competition Act 1998, see section 43(1A).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
